$comment: The Refiner's structured output. The worker asks the model for it and the API validates it again before storing a spec version.

summary.description: What and why, in two to four sentences

evidence.description: Repository files that ground the spec; every path must be one you read

path.description: Path relative to the repository root

note.description: Why this code matters to the task

verified.description: Set by the worker: the path and lines exist at the inspected commit

ambiguities.description: Open questions for the person who wrote the brief

approach.description: Suggested implementation steps; the agent never performs them

readiness.description: How ready the task is to implement without further questions
